simple.meaning: אָבִיב (ʼâbîyb) is a Hebrew word meaning “green , i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אָבִיב (H24) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 9:31, with occurrences in Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָבִיב (H24) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אָבִיב (H24) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אָבִיב (ʼâbîyb) / H24 is traced through Exodus 9:31, Exodus 13:4, Exodus 23:15, Exodus 34:18 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: green , i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan
definitions.usage: Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).
definitions.full: H24. abib אָבִיב noun masculine Lev 2:14 collective (Lag BN 207 Infinitive) 1 fresh, young ears of barley Exod 9:31 ; indefinite Lev 2:14 א ליהוה בִּכּוּרִים ׳מִנְחַת בָּאֵשׁ קָלוּי . 2 הָֽאָבִיב חֹדֶשׁ month of ear-forming, or of growing green, Abib, month of Exodus & passover, Exod 13:4 ; 23:15 ; 34:18 (twice in verse) (JE), Deut 16:1 (twice in verse) (1st month = circa April = הָר ׳הַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשֹׁן, (q. v.) in P; see Di Exod 12:2 ; = post-exilic נִיסָן q. v.) אֲבִגַיִל see אֲבִיגַיִל below II. אבה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root (meaning to be tender );
